svg.title: Reconnect watchdog and supervisor recovery connections
svg.desc: Inputs, outputs, durable state, evidence, failure, and recovery relationships for Reconnect watchdog and supervisor recovery.

g.text: Reconnect watchdog and supervisor recovery connections

a.xlink:title: Reconnect watchdog and supervisor recovery. Separates running-but-disconnected recovery from stopped-agent recovery and exposes truthful guidance when no supervisor is available.
Lite agent supervisor. Runs separately from the agent, reads the protected agent environment, and starts or restarts failed agents without overwriting identity.
Lite node agent. Connects to NATS, publishes heartbeat/telemetry/health, handles device commands, and reconnects after outages.
a.text: Server host or joined device · PM2
